com/live2d/cubism/doc/modeling/CModelingDocument::getDocumentUID()Ljava/lang/String; is absent on every 5.0.x jar (MEMBER_MISSING); the document-UID identity chain the autobackup session depends on was introduced in 5.1 — 5.0.x exposes only getFileContentInstanceGuid().

com/live2d/cubism/doc/modeling/CModelingDocument::getDocumentUID()Ljava/lang/String; is absent on every 5.0.x jar (MEMBER_MISSING); the document-UID identity chain the autobackup session depends on was introduced in 5.1 — 5.0.x exposes only getFileContentInstanceGuid().

Three incompatible members on every 5.0.x jar: export driver com/live2d/cubism/appCtrlImpl/al::a(CModelSource;CFrame;Function1)V takes Function1 (5.1+ uses Function2 — the staged output-file + absolute-path-list callback contract does not exist), CModelSource::containMotionSyncSettingNeedCorrection()Z missing, CMotionSyncSettingSource::getMotionSyncVersion() missing. The reviewed transformation premise fails closed.

Field com/live2d/cubism/view/CEMainFrameCtrl$CEMainFrameViewCtrl::toolBtn_openHomeDialog and its accessor (q()Lcom/live2d/ui/control/CIconButton;) are absent on every 5.0.x jar (DESCRIPTOR_MISMATCH — q() returns CButton); the home-dialog toolbar button was introduced in 5.1.00.

Field com/live2d/cubism/view/CEMainFrameCtrl$CEMainFrameViewCtrl::toolBtn_openHomeDialog and its accessor (q()Lcom/live2d/ui/control/CIconButton;) are absent on every 5.0.x jar (DESCRIPTOR_MISMATCH — q() returns CButton); the home-dialog toolbar button was introduced in 5.1.00.

Package com/live2d/cubism/doc/webSocket contains zero classes in every 5.0.x jar (100 classes in 5.1.00); all 10 external-app selectors (com/live2d/cubism/doc/webSocket/l, l$a, x) report CLASS_MISSING.
Package com/live2d/cubism/autoYure contains zero classes in every 5.0.x jar (59 classes in 5.1.00); the auto-sway document model was introduced in 5.1.

On 5.0.x the com/live2d/cubism/doc/webSocket package is absent entirely (CLASS_MISSING on all 10 dispatch selectors). On 5.1.00/5.1.01 the session-lookup com/live2d/cubism/doc/webSocket/l::b(Lorg/java_websocket/WebSocket;) is private (contract requires public+final) and the only public bridge is static (forbidden by the selector); the session class is webSocket/aa with a different auth manager call shape (CExternalAppAuthManager.getAuth(String) vs getAuth(String,String) on 5.1.02+).
Package com/live2d/cubism/doc/webSocket contains zero classes in every 5.0.x jar; the external-app settings dialog selectors are CLASS_MISSING on all 5.0.x.

com/live2d/cubism/doc/animation/movie/effect/attr/CMvAttrF::setValueAndCurveType(ID;Lcom/live2d/cubism/doc/animation/movie/effect/attr/value/CCurveType;)V is absent on every 5.0.x/5.1.x jar — timeline curve-type writes were introduced in 5.2.

com/live2d/cubism/doc/animation/movie/track/CMvTrack_Live2DModel_Instance::getParameterSet() is absent on every 5.0.x/5.1.x jar, and the timeline-write roster (CMvAttrF::setValueAndCurveType) the eval bake path requires is also absent — evaluated-parameter recording cannot complete.
com/live2d/cubism/doc/model/parts/CPartForm::getOpacity()F / setOpacity(F)V are absent on every 5.0.x/5.1.x/5.2.x jar — part-form opacity accessors were introduced in 5.3.

Core deformer/glue geometry read requires com/live2d/sdk/cubism/core/CubismDeformers and CubismGlues plus CubismModel.getDeformers/getGlues; both classes are absent from Live2DCubismCore.jar on all reviewed 5.0/5.1 builds and first appear in 5.2.00.

Selection-brush ingress requires com/live2d/cubism/CEAppCtrl.getCurrentViewContextChangedListeners()Ljava/util/ArrayList; and the currentViewContextChangedListeners field; both are absent on all reviewed 5.0/5.1 jars and first appear in 5.2.00 (the modeling-tool view listener API was added in 5.2).
